integrity: The proof uses exact stationarity identities and a global sign property, not finite-time numerical evidence.
The bundled checker verifies exact coefficient and specialization arithmetic only; it is not presented as a proof of infinite-time dynamics.
Source comparison distinguishes the present nonpolynomial error-function flow from polynomial jerk families.
scientific_limitations: The printed decimal coefficients are interpreted as exact decimal values.
The result does not rigorously establish existence or ergodicity of the numerically reported hidden attractor.
At the critical parameter, uniqueness is proved for compactly supported invariant probability measures, not for every possible nonrecurrent compact orbit structure.
No claim is made about unbounded trajectories or global existence outside compact invariant sets.
title: Exact compact-recurrence threshold and stationary variance defect for an error-function jerk flow
